sources.title: Huihui-Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Claude-4.7-Opus-abliterated
sources.snippet: This is a 35.9B parameter mixture-of-experts model derived from Qwen 3.6, fine-tuned with Claude 4.7 reasoning distillation and then modified ('abliterated') to remove safety filtering. The model card explicitly warns that safety guardrails have been significantly reduced and outputs may be sensitive, controversial, or inappropriate.

sources.title: Huihui Qwen3.6 35B A3B Claude 4.7 Opus Abliterated
sources.snippet: Chat Reasoning Huihui Qwen3.6 35B A3B Claude 4.7 Opus Abliterated is a 36.0B-parameter open language model from huihui-ai in the Qwen 3.6 family. It supports a context window of up to 262,144 tokens. At Q4_K_M it needs about 21.95 GB of VRAM — see which GPUs and Macs can run it below.
